fitbit-web-api.name: Fitbit Web API
fitbit-web-api.quote: The Fitbit Web API and Fitbit OAuth endpoints will be turned off and will no longer function or sync data to or from Fitbit users. Requests to these endpoints will fail and return an HTTP 410 Gone status code.

migrate.label: Fitbit Web API to Google Health API migration

terra-legacy-widget-session.name: Terra legacy widget session endpoint
terra-legacy-widget-session.quote: Existing integrations keep working today, and the legacy endpoint is planned for deprecation on 3 November 2026. Accounts created after 3 September 2026 cannot use it at all.

google-fit-apis.name: Google Fit APIs (Android and REST)
google-fit-apis.quote: The Google Fit API (including the REST API) will only be supported until the end of 2026. We recommend migrating to the Google Health API for cloud-based integrations or Health Connect for step tracking and mobile-first apps.

google-fit-goals-api.name: Google Fit Goals API
google-fit-goals-api.quote: No replacement API available. Manage goal tracking and daily activity targets within your application logic.

google-fit-sensors-ble-apis.name: Google Fit Sensors API and BLE API
google-fit-sensors-ble-apis.quote: The following features don't have a direct API replacement. Use the recommended Android standard APIs:

replacedBy.label: Android Sensors framework or Fused Location Provider (Sensors API)

strava-club-endpoints.name: Strava Club Activities, Club Members and Club Admins endpoints
strava-club-endpoints.quote: Club Activities, Club Members, and Club Admins endpoints removed

samsung-health-sdk-android.name: Samsung Health SDK for Android
samsung-health-sdk-android.quote: Samsung Health SDK for Android has been depricated as of 31 July, 2025. Please use Samsung Health Data SDK to access Samsung Health data to integrate with Samsung Health.

oura-api-v1.name: Oura API V1
oura-api-v1.quote: The V1 API was removed on January 22nd, 2024.

migrate.label: How to integrate the Oura API

oura-personal-access-tokens.name: Oura personal access tokens
oura-personal-access-tokens.quote: Please note that personal access tokens were deprecated in December 2025 and are no longer available for use.

whoop-api-v1.name: WHOOP API v1
whoop-api-v1.quote: The v1 API is no longer supported and any new features or functionality will be added to v2 only.

migrate.label: How to integrate the WHOOP API

mediapipe-legacy-pose.name: MediaPipe Pose (Legacy Solution)
mediapipe-legacy-pose.quote: As of May 10, 2023, this solution was upgraded to a new MediaPipe Solution.

tfjs-posenet.name: PoseNet for TensorFlow.js (@tensorflow-models/posenet)
tfjs-posenet.quote: This package is deprecated in favor of the new pose-detection package.

strava-running-races.name: Strava Running Races endpoints
strava-running-races.quote: The get running race and list races endpoints will start to return empty values starting October 15th, 2021, and will be removed completely by November 1st, 2021.

moves-api.name: Moves app and developer API
moves-api.quote: As of July 31, 2018, you can no longer log in or use the Moves app.

google-health-2008.name: Google Health (personal health record service)
google-health-2008.quote: Google Health (retiring January 1, 2012; data available for download through January 1, 2013)
